description:
Endgame ship recovery done right.
Download
Requires LunaLib
Author: Zman147

Mod description

Spoiler
A simple mod that allows Threat, Shrouded, and omega ships to be recoverable when the automated ships skill is aquired

I wanted to make an updated version of the Everything recoverable/salvage everything mod, but i wanted to do it in a more vanilla-friendly way.
Features:
- LunaSettings integration easy customization (more settings coming soon!! requests are needed)
- Tweaked OP values on vanilla ships where extremely high ones were before, I left everything else alone.

Roadmap:

Spoiler
-more interactive station recovery (using the tug class of ships to pull stations with your fleet, capture stations from enemy colonies, and bring them to your own)
- Ashes of the domain integration (Thinking about researching the recovery of endgame ships by using loot collected from them, also thinking about possibly having specific structures that produce endgame ships. would love to expand the scope of Dwellers and Omega influence on the sector

Compatible Modded Ships

Spoiler
-omega ships from Missing Ships Supers Pack

Would love to hear your thoughts, questions, and issues.
Until then
Enjoy!!!
